tours.name: Respond to Alerts
tours.outcome: Triggered greenhouse environmental or pest alert is reviewed and acknowledged.

steps.title: Record threshold breach when sensor reading or pest detection meets rule condition (the alert becomes triggered). Rule: Condition must persist for configured duration or meet confidence threshold
View alert details and recent zone history on dashboard (the alert becomes viewed)
Acknowledge alert to confirm awareness and ongoing response (the alert becomes acknowledged). Rule: Operator must be signed in

tours.name: Review Pest Detections
tours.outcome: Camera pest detection snapshot is validated or dismissed.

steps.title: Receive camera snapshot with detected pest and confidence score (the detection becomes pending). Rule: Snapshot must include identified pest and confidence score
Review detection snapshot and confidence score (the detection becomes reviewed)
Confirm pest presence for targeted treatment (the detection becomes confirmed). Rule: Operator must verify image details

tours.name: Manage Device Health
tours.outcome: Unresponsive or low-health device is identified and issued a reboot command.

steps.title: Check dashboard for offline devices and low battery indicators (the device becomes flagged)
Send reboot command to unresponsive device (the device becomes rebooting). Rule: Only administrators can issue device commands
